acceptance_invariants: No public API, constructor signature, authored XML bytes, source span, or public error family changes.
Public semantic decoding remains lazy; only the historical inventory local_state boundary may force it.
Validation/error order remains codec raw validation, focused footnote validation, then deferred semantic decode; inventory preflight limits remain earlier.
NamespaceContext shadowing/restoration and self-contained declaration accounting remain exact, including default and remapped prefixes.
Tolerance defect offsets are reported in original main-document coordinates after any synthetic insertion.
Footnote Context/ignorable semantics are either preserved exactly or changed only by an explicit, tested private context route; no extension is skipped.
Failures do not publish partial inventory/output, and no-op/changed/inverse source preservation remains byte exact.

constraints_applied: Preserve authored bytes and unknown markup; private views do not become public API.
Keep source identity, finite limits, deterministic typed refusals, and atomic source-checked publication.
A lazy or reused representation must not move an error/refusal without an explicit accepted contract.

coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.case: Build a structurally valid sectPr with a semantic-only invalid known value and valid footnote state.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.expected: Section::from_xml_bytes succeeds; the first semantic accessor/local_state returns the existing semantic Error family. A private inventory reuse path may decode eagerly at its historical local_state boundary, but must not make the public constructor eager.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.why: Existing tests exercise semantic values but do not pin constructor-success versus first-access failure as a reuse invariant.

coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.case: Use one section with malformed codec topology/QName and malformed footnoteColumns payload.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.expected: The codec validation error wins, matching Section::from_xml_bytes order; no footnote or semantic error may replace it. Compare variant and stable diagnostic/resource context.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.why: A shared raw parse can accidentally reorder focused-footnote work or expose a later error first.

coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.case: Use structurally valid XML with malformed footnoteColumns and a separate semantic-only invalid Word property.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.expected: Construction fails with the focused footnote error before semantic decode. With valid footnote XML, construction succeeds and the semantic error remains at local_state/first semantic access.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.why: Pins the current validate -> footnote parse -> deferred codec decode sequence.

coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.case: Combine an over-limit relationship ID/reference total or max_section_bytes violation (including injected xmlns bytes) with a semantic error.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.expected: The existing SectionInventoryLimit resource and observed/maximum details win before private raw/footnote/semantic materialization. max_section_bytes charges source plus the exact declarations that self_contained_fragment would add, even if a future route avoids the Vec.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.why: Existing inventory_preflights_reference_limits_before_semantic_retention and inventory_bounds_inherited_namespace_materialization are the required order controls.

coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.case: Use inherited default/Word, relationship, MC, and extension aliases; include a nested prefix rebind to a foreign URI, a quoted > attribute, and both nonempty and self-closing sectPr roots.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.expected: Only Word-bound sections are captured; outer aliases resume after nested scope exit; self_contained_fragment adds each missing binding once, does not duplicate root declarations, and does not leak synthetic xmlns bytes into source spans or public output.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.why: Current tests cover scanner scope and some injection shape separately, but not their combined source-span/temporary-fragment contract.

coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.case: Put tolerated w:cols/w:col deviations and a nonconforming relationship ID in a section whose fragment needs multiple inherited declarations.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.expected: Defect kinds/order are unchanged and every context equals the original main-document offset, including paragraph-owned and body-final sections; no synthetic insertion delta is double-subtracted.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.why: Detached Section offsets are covered, but inventory mapping with multiple injected declarations is not.

coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.case: Compare absent extension, explicit w12:footnoteColumns val=0, local remapped alias with local mc:Ignorable, and inherited mc:Ignorable/context variants. Include malformed value and missing-ignorable controls.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.expected: None and Some(Layout{count:0}) remain distinct; malformed/missing-ignorable errors remain typed and ordered; authored XML is unchanged. If inherited context is newly supported, it must use an explicit out-of-band Context equivalent to footnote_columns::parse_part. If not supported, the current rejection must remain a stable refusal rather than being silently accepted or skipped.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.why: Focused footnote tests cover these cases detached/package-wise, but Inventory’s synthetic fragment path does not combine them; self_contained_fragment injects namespace declarations, not inherited mc:Ignorable attributes.

coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.case: Run the existing source-backed section edit, no-op, changed publish, and inverse controls on a document using inherited/remapped namespaces and a footnote extension.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.expected: Descriptor values, tolerance report, output, and inverse bytes match the baseline route; temporary validation state cannot become publication source or alter unknown/opaque markup.
coverage_gaps_and_required_cases.why: This is the smallest end-to-end preservation control after the private reuse path lands; it is not a request for a new broad matrix.

codec_and_footnote: codec::validate parses only the bounded raw topology; codec::decode parses raw topology again and then decode_state applies semantic checks/tolerance.
footnote_columns::Snapshot::from_xml_with_context retains an out-of-band namespace/ignorable Context; package::parse_part is the existing inherited-context precedent.
inventory: inventory::NamespaceContext tracks active prefix bindings and restores shadowed bindings on scope exit.
append_section checks source length, section count, and reference preflight before parsing the selected section.
self_contained_fragment injects missing root xmlns declarations, charges source plus inserted bytes against max_section_bytes, and returns a temporary Vec.
append_section calls Section::from_xml_bytes(fragment), then local_state(), then maps tolerance contexts from synthetic-fragment offsets back to original document offsets.
current_seam.optimization_boundary: Any fragment/raw reuse must stay private to inventory/section internals. The public Section constructor, authored XML, lazy semantic timing, and footnote validation contract remain unchanged.
public_section: Section::from_xml_bytes at model.rs:444 calls codec::validate first, then footnote_columns::Snapshot::from_xml, and leaves codec::Snapshot unset.
snapshot_mut at model.rs:770 is the first semantic codec::decode; local_state/tolerance_report therefore force semantic decoding.
footnote_columns_snapshot at model.rs:643 reparses the authored/current section XML through the focused footnote codec.

execution.note: Read-only source and accepted-ADR review; no runtime or quality command was started.

absent versus explicit zero, out-of-band inherited Context, ignorable requirements, malformed extension refusal, alias collisions, and authored-byte preservation
public source-backed publication/inverse and preservation controls, but does not directly exercise inventory append_section plus footnote validation together

No iWork or unrelated workspace boundary audit.
